title: Birbal and the Rich Man’s Pride
moral: Pride limits your thinking—stay humble to grow.

scenes.summary: A rich man boasts about his wealth.
scenes.text: One day, a rich man came to Emperor Akbar and proudly said he was the richest in the city.
scenes.image_prompt: rich man showing pride in royal court, cartoon style

scenes.summary: The rich man behaves arrogantly toward others.
scenes.text: The man treated others badly because of his pride. Akbar asked Birbal to teach him a lesson.
scenes.image_prompt: rich man acting arrogant while others look upset, cartoon

scenes.summary: Birbal takes the man to a field.
scenes.text: Birbal took the rich man to a large field and drew a small circle on the ground.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal drawing small circle on ground in open field, cartoon

scenes.summary: Birbal shows how perspective changes with a bigger circle.
scenes.text: Birbal asked the man to stand inside the circle, then drew a bigger circle and asked what he could see.
scenes.image_prompt: man standing inside small and large circles comparing views, cartoon

scenes.summary: The rich man understands the lesson and feels ashamed.
scenes.text: Birbal explained that pride limits thinking. The man understood and felt ashamed. Pride limits your thinking—stay humble to grow.
scenes.image_prompt: rich man realizing mistake while birbal explains, soft cartoon style

story: One day, a rich man boasted to Emperor Akbar that he was the richest in the city and treated others poorly. Birbal took him to a field and drew a small circle, asking him to stand inside it. Then he drew a larger circle and showed how his view expanded. Birbal explained that pride limits thinking, and the rich man felt ashamed.
